findings.title: actions/checkout is pinned to a mutable reference
findings.summary: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs actions/checkout at `v4`, a tag or branch the action's owner can repoint at any time. A compromised or retagged action executes with this workflow's token.
findings.recommended_remediation: Pin the action to a full 40-character commit SHA and record the intended version in a comment.

reproduction.summary: Re-read the workflow and match the same construct.

findings.title: .github/workflows/ci.yml declares no GITHUB_TOKEN permissions
findings.summary: Without an explicit `permissions:` block the workflow inherits the repository default, which may grant write access to contents, packages and more than the job needs.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add `permissions: {contents: read}` and widen only where required.

reproduction.summary: Re-read the workflow and match the same construct.

findings.title: `esc` does not escape the single quote but is used inside a JavaScript string literal
findings.summary: `esc` escapes ", &, <, > and not the single quote (defined at frontend/mission_view.howl:64). At frontend/mission_view.howl:134 its output is placed inside a single-quoted JavaScript string in an event-handler attribute. The HTML parser decodes the attribute before JavaScript parses it, so a single quote in the value terminates the string literal and everything after it becomes code. Escaping the double quote prevents breaking out of the attribute; it does not prevent breaking out of the string.
findings.evidence:
tton type=\"button\" class=\"mission-row s-" (call esc st) "\""
              " onclick=\"window.open_mission('" (call esc id) "')\">") ""))
findings.recommended_remediation: Escape the single quote in the escape function, or stop embedding values in handler attributes and bind the listener in code instead. Escaping for HTML text is not sufficient for a JavaScript context.

reproduction.summary: Re-read the source and match the same construction.

findings.title: Stored data executes as script in the interface: mission_id_js_string
findings.summary: A mission identifier carrying a single quote, placed in the fixture the seed endpoint loads. Identifiers created through the API are server assigned, but seeded and ledger-imported records keep whatever identifier the source document carried.. A value placed at /missions/0/id in data/fixtures/missions.json and loaded through the artifact's own seed path set `window.__howlproof_injection` when the interface rendered it, which means the value was parsed as code rather than displayed as text.

    "file": "data/fixtures/missions.json",
